raw021.subject: Let clients approve/reject individual items on a board
raw021.description:
Pattern across my accounts: the client gets the board link, then sends the designer WhatsApp voice notes like "love the sofa, hate the lamp, what's the price of the rug in the second photo". The designer then compiles feedback by hand.

Three studios asked me some version of "can the client just mark what they like directly on the board" this month.

Feels like the missing half of the boards feature — clients can comment but can't actually decide anything.
